policyText: No payment now. If you cancel less than 1 hour before your appointment, or don't come, Izzy Clipz may charge $55–$60 (100% of the service) to this card within 7 days after your appointment time. Cancelling online is free more than 1 hour before, or within 15 minutes of booking.

warning.title: Late Cancellation & No-Show Fee
warning.message: Cancelling less than 1 hour before your appointment, or not showing up, may be charged the full service price ($55–$60). Cancelling online more than 1 hour before, or within 15 minutes of booking, is free.
